documents.text: Kevin Jones (basketball) Kevin Andrew Jones (born August 25, 1989) is an American professional basketball player who plays for Nanterre 92. He played college basketball for West Virginia University. Jones attended Mount Vernon High School in Mount Vernon, New York. As a junior, he averaged 21 points, 12 rebounds, two blocks per game. As a senior, he averaged 23 points, 14 rebounds, and two blocks per game. In 2006 and 2007, he led Mount Vernon to the New York State PHSAA championships.
